类 InMemoryLibraryService

java.lang.Object
cn.vcampus.library.InMemoryLibraryService
所有已实现的接口:
LibraryCatalogV4, LibraryService
public final class InMemoryLibraryService extends Object implements LibraryService, LibraryCatalogV4
In-memory facade; the default keeps loan history empty for isolated tests.
